Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- High latency on current LLM endpoint during peak traffic (esp. search/autocomplete flows).
- Cost unpredictability with current provider (token spikes on multi-turn workflows).
- Need for strict data isolation for PII-sensitive logs and auditability.

Goals / success metrics:
- Reduce 95th percentile latency for autocomplete to <120ms per request.
- Reduce per-token serving cost by 25% vs current baseline.
- Meet internal security requirements: SOC 2 evidence, VPC/private deployment option, and KMS integration.

Stakeholders / decision process (as discussed):
- Technical eval owner: Sofia Martinez (Procurement will coordinate contracting)
- Eng technical lead: Alex Johnson (will lead the POC + workshop)
- Executive sponsor: VP Product (TBD; decision expected after POC)
- Legal/Procurement: Sofia (procurement@acme.com)

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Intro to procurement + legal — Mar 18, 2027 — Sofia — Share contract template and procurement timeline (action: Alex to intro Sofia)
2) Technical workshop & env review — Mar 22, 2027 — Alex (Acme) + Rishi/Marissa (Redwood) — 90-min deep dive covering infra, VPC options, and KV cache behavior
3) POC kickoff (2 weeks) — Mar 29, 2027 — Acme engineering with Redwood dedicated support — success criteria: latency & cost benchmarks
4) Security review & SOC2 evidence exchange — concurrent with POC — continuous — Legal/Security teams
5) Decision & purchase order — Apr 16, 2027 — Exec sponsor + Procurement

Attachments: I’ve attached the decision timeline you shared and will follow up with a first draft MAP from our side.
(attachment: acme-decision-timeline.xlsx)

Next steps / asks for you:
- Please confirm Sofia as the procurement contact and her availability for Mar 18.
- Share any additional compliance docs your security team needs up front (I can route SOC 2 / audit artifacts).
- Confirm availability for the technical workshop on Mar 22.

If that looks right I’ll send a formal MAP doc with owners/dates and a calendar invite for the workshop.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
